briefdescription.para: Inserts any necessary instructions at position Pos relative to instruction MI to ensure any subsequent memory instructions of this thread with address spaces AddrSpace will observe the previous memory operations by any thread for memory scopes up to memory scope Scope .

detaileddescription.para: Returns true iff any instructions inserted.

inbodydescription.para: The scratch address space does not need the global memory cache to be flushed as all memory operations by the same thread are sequentially consistent, and no other thread can access scratch memory.
